name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

keywords: tomato macaroni soup, comfort food, pasta soup

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Macaroni Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and meat casserole topped with cheese and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 cups grated cheese (e.g., cheddar, mozzarella, Monterey Jack)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, cheesy pasta bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.
Puree the mixture until smooth.
Heat with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Macaroni Salad
_similar.description: A classic macaroni salad with tuna, ham, and cheddar cheese, mixed with Miracle Whip and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Let cool.
Cut up celery, cheese, tuna, and ham into small pieces.
Combine cooled macaroni with the tuna mixture.
Add enough Miracle Whip to moisten the salad.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes and paprika.
Mix well and serve.

_similar.keywords: macaroni salad, tuna salad, cheddar cheese
